description: This file implements URL scanning functionality using Cloudflare's URL Scanner API, including URL extraction from HTML, submitting URLs for scanning (single and bulk), polling for scan results, and locking users if malicious URLs are detected.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Extracts error message from an unknown error object.

methods.name: createErrorResult
methods.description: Creates a UrlScanResult object representing an error state.

methods.name: isValidHttpUrl
methods.description: Validates if a URL string is a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL.

methods.name: normalizeUrl
methods.description: Normalizes URLs for deduplication by removing trailing slashes.

methods.name: extractUrlsFromHtml
methods.description: Extracts URLs from HTML content, including href attributes and plain URLs.

methods.name: submitUrlForScanning
methods.description: Submits a single URL to Cloudflare for scanning and returns the scan ID or error.

methods.name: processBulkScanResponse
methods.description: Processes bulk scan API response and updates results map.

methods.name: submitUrlsForBulkScanning
methods.description: Submits multiple URLs for bulk scanning, handling batching and API responses.

methods.name: parseScanResultResponse
methods.description: Parses scan result response from Cloudflare API into UrlScanResult.

methods.name: getScanResult
methods.description: Retrieves the scan result for a given scan ID from Cloudflare.

methods.name: scanUrls
methods.description: Performs URL scanning for multiple URLs, polling for results.

methods.name: checkUrlsAndLockIfMalicious
methods.description: Checks URLs for malicious content and locks user if any malicious URLs are found.

methods.name: isUrlScanningEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether URL scanning is enabled.
